links.outcome: VUS reclassification rate of candidate AI versus another variant classification platform on same variants
links.effect: Reclassification rate was 86.1% for VarCard.io vs 34.8% for Franklin (p<0.001), showing large differences between competing tools on the same data.
links.quote: The reclassification rate was significantly higher for VarCard.io than for Franklin (86.1% vs 34.8%, p<0.001).

screen.reason: Retrospectively evaluates the clinical utility and diagnostic concordance of AlphaMissense (a protein language model accessed via a variant annotation tool) on real-world patient genetic variants, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
